div.style: color: rgb(36, 26, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

NOT_TESTED — deliberately OUTSIDE the ladder — this assay structurally cannot see it.
Never comparable to, and never downgradable into, NO_ACTION
